description: This file defines an abstract controller class for handling file responses in a web application, including methods for creating file responses, setting HTTP headers, and managing download dispositions.

classes.name: AbstractFileController
classes.description: An abstract controller providing file download response handling, including response setup with headers and disposition encoding.

methods.name: getNewFileResponse
methods.description: Creates and returns a new BinaryFileResponse object for the specified file.

methods.name: getFileResponse
methods.description: Returns an existing BinaryFileResponse object or creates a new one if none exists.

methods.name: makeAttachmentDisposition
methods.description: Generates a Content-Disposition header value for file attachment with proper encoding.

methods.name: setCommonHeadersToResponse
methods.description: Sets standard headers on the HTTP response for file download, including content type, length, and cache directives.
